notablePrerequisites:
Accomplished Alchemist does not have summoning sickness. You have gained at least 4 life this turn.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Accomplished Alchemist
description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Accomplished Alchemist
Repeat.
